---
title: "CIFAR/Keras Image Classifier"
---

Upload an image below to try the CIFAR Image Classification model, built with Tensorflow and Keras and trained on 60,000 images in the CIFAR-10 dataset. **Current categories: airplane, automobile, bird, cat, deer, dog, frog, horse, ship, truck**. If possible, images should be taken of real-life objects (no video game vehicles, for example) and most of the subject should be visible.

*This project was built with Python 3.12, Tensorflow 2.20, Keras, and the CIFAR-10 dataset. It achieved 0.79 training accuracy and performs pretty well on most images you feed into it. Project commentary and applicable notebooks are coming soon on the site's Blog page.*
